issue.title: Task-bead backlog, epic 2: fix the five most important open task beads
issue.description: The five most important workable task beads in the sase project are resolved on master and closed with recorded evidence: sase-1og (the check-full flake-baseline gate exits 2 before judging anything), sase-18t (ToolRun store "database is locked" under parallel load), sase-1a7 (the Files ctrl+j anchor-scroll node that keeps Full CI red), sase-12f (the monitor-capacity fakey e2e that exits 124 under load), and sase-1ot (owner-approved rotation and purge of 27 historical secret-scanner hits in public sase--agents history). The land agent then starts the next backlog epic, five beads at a time, until no workable task bead remains.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/backlog_epic_2_top_five_task_beads.md requests this work

issue.title: Make the flake-baseline gate reach a truthful verdict again (sase-1og)
issue.description: flake-baseline: drop the duplicate fixed-at directive that makes tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake exit 2, add a regression test that parses the committed baseline, then reconcile the 64 exceedances the unmasked gate reports (fixed-at for verified fixes, baseline entries only under existing open beads, follow-ups for the rest), and close sase-1og.

issue.title: Stop the ToolRun store failing with "database is locked" under parallel load (sase-18t)
issue.description: toolrun-busy: identify which sase-core ToolRun store transactions hold the SQLite write lock while launcher, settle and show paths read it, fix the contention at its source in sase-core with a principled busy policy, move the core pin, retire the tests/tool/ baseline entries with fixed-at, and close sase-18t.

issue.description: capacity-e2e: find what consumes the fakey land agent's 5 s budget under load in tests/fakey/test_monitor_capacity_e2e.py (delayed child bootstrap, capacity scan under the host-wide slot lock, or harness polling), fix the cause instead of the timeout, prove it with a loaded stress loop, and close sase-12f.

payload.entry: Planning evidence: no prior phase implementation notes were present. The opened agents-sidecar history at observed tip cdf4e8cf60 still contains audited tip 5066d26a4b234769f48be023e92038d9d9727c0f. Verified both private audit attachment checksums. The 27-hit report covers one tree, not full history; the core scanner emits only a first finding and known-value coverage changes after rotation. Prepared a four-phase child epic with parent_bead=sase-1ou.5: private triage, fleet maintenance protocol, isolated purge rehearsal, and gated execution/verification. Both plan validations passed with zero warnings. No product files, secrets, publication settings, services or histories changed. epic-symbols reports no entries. This phase remains in progress pending the approved child work and its lander; outer epic and source task closure remain with their authorized owners.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: import-budget recurrence — tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py fails deterministic on clean base (3541 modules vs 3539 cap; 146 gate-countable failures 09-28..10-27, fails focused too); closed sase-1ic tracked an earlier instance (3576 vs 3570, closed done 10-26); needs owner triage (defer imports or +1/reopen sase-1ic), left as gate exceedance

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: stale TUI pilot load-flake cluster (all pass focused at base, last gate-countable failures early-Oct, no open bead) — panel_shell semicolon, screenshot_export tolerates_signal, launch_context_bar agents_row_fit (closed sase-1g2), artifacts_limit_keys ctrl_j (closed sase-1fy), prompt_next_word auto_space (closed sase-1ib), directive_completion x4 (matches_aliases, includes_representative, ctrl_t_alias, percent_partial), prompt_tab_focus_steal x5, launch_context_source every_tick, top_bar busy_cluster, agent_display_workflow_async, meta_priority project_shown, scoreboard conformance_warns, agy usage_probe; 19 nodes left as gate exceedances for land-agent triage

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: doc-phrase audit flake cluster (pass focused, recent gate evidence) — test_agent_session_terminology (failures to 10-21) and test_sase_turn_terminology (to 10-23); no open bead and no attributable fix commit found; left as gate exceedances

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: misc load-flake cluster (all pass focused at base, no open bead; closed-bead refs where they exist) — kind_coverage, agents_sync bounded_drain (11x 10-13..10-20), commit_publication_inline tagged_commit (10-21..10-24), new_project owner_switch (10-18), monitor_handler start_implicit (to 10-25), proc_producer inventory (to 10-24), isolation_guards x2 (to 10-21), agent_launch_executor preallocated (10-03), deferred_workspace_flow (10-17), plan_validate facade (closed sase-1k5; 10-11/10-17 failures postdate the corrects change 117f4cebbc, fix unidentified), plugin_latest enrich (closed sase-1jt; env-dependent spread 10-03..10-14), started_at home_mode marker (closed sase-1mf; burst 10-17 incl. trees containing f2a7b802f9, fix unidentified); 14 nodes left as gate exceedances

Flake-baseline gate reaches a truthful verdict: duplicate fixed-at dropped (kept 2026-09-22 instant, both commits named), regression test added (20/20 pass, fails on pre-fix file), 64 exceedances reconciled to 41 (14 baselined under sase-18t/sase-13a/sase-1em/sase-137/sase-1nr/sase-1ny; 9 fixed-at with verified fixes; 49 dead directives + closed-bead entries pruned), gate exits 1 not 2, sase tool run check 58064 passed with only the 3 known clean-base reds. Owned task sase-1og closed done. Remaining 41 = 5 epic-owned (sase-1oj/sase-1om) + 36 in 4 follow-up notes; epic-symbols clean.
